```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
tm = 'VAN'
file_hit <- paste0('data/',tm,'_hit.csv')
file_pit <- paste0('data/',tm,'_pit.csv')
# Install packages if you don't already have them:
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sportyR"))

library(tidyverse)
library(sportyR)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r roster-data, echo=F}
pos_order <- c("c", "1b", "2b", "3b", "ss", "lf", "cf", "rf", "dh")

dc_hit <- read.csv(file_hit) |> 
  select(Name,Pos,PA,RC27)
sorted_hit <- dc_hit |> 
  mutate(Pos = factor(Pos, levels = pos_order)) |> 
  arrange(desc(PA)) |> 
  group_by(Pos)

top_2 <- sorted_hit |> 
  slice(1:2) |> 
  ungroup()
other_hit <- sorted_hit |> 
  slice(-(1:2)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  arrange(desc(PA))
dc_hit <- dc_hit |> 
  mutate(Pos = factor(Pos, levels = pos_order)) |> 
  arrange(Pos,desc(PA))
dc_pit <- read.csv(file_pit) |> 
  select(Name,Pos,GS,BF,RC27)
dc_sp <- dc_pit |> filter(Pos == 'sp') |> select(-BF) |> arrange(desc(GS)) |> slice(1:6)
colnames(dc_sp) <- colnames(dc_hit)
dc_rp <- dc_pit |> filter(Pos != 'sp',BF>=150) |> select(-GS) |> arrange(RC27) |> slice(1:5)
dc_rp$Pos = 'rp'
colnames(dc_rp) <- colnames(dc_hit)
pit_names <- unique(c(dc_rp$Name,dc_sp$Name))
other_pit <- dc_pit |> filter(!Name %in% pit_names)
roster <- rbind(top_2,dc_sp,dc_rp)
```

```{r depth-chart, fig.width=9, fig.height=5,dpi=150}
# 2. Define X, Y coordinates on the sportyR field (in feet from home plate)
pos_coords <- tribble(
  ~Pos, ~x,   ~y,
  "sp",    0,   80,
  "rp", -140, 40,
  "c",    0,  -18,
  "1b",  110,   110,
  "2b",  60,  165,
  "ss", -60,  165,
  "3b", -110,   110,
  "lf",-130,  230,
  "cf",   0,  240,
  "rf", 130,  230,
  "dh", 140,   40   # Placed near the first-base dugout
)
#pos_coords$x <- pos_coords$x*.8
pos_coords$y <- pos_coords$y*.8+10
# 3. Group by position, sort by PA (descending), and build the text box per position
depth_chart_df <- roster %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  mutate(line = sprintf("%s (%d | %.1f)", Name, PA, RC27)) %>%
  summarise(
    label = paste0(first(Pos), "\n", paste(line, collapse = "\n")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(pos_coords, by = "Pos")

# 4. Draw the baseball field and overlay the depth chart labels
geom_baseball(league = "MLB",
                color_updates = list(
                  #plot_background = "#7CFC00",
                  infield_grass = "#78a66f"),
              xlims = c(-190,190),
              ylims = .8*c(-20, 270)) +
  geom_label(
    data = depth_chart_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = alpha("lightgray", 0.90),
    color = "#1a1a1a",
    label.padding = unit(0.35, "lines"),
    label.r = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    lineheight = 1.15
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(tm,"Depth Chart"),
    subtitle = "(Stats shown: Usage (PA or GS or BF) | RC27)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = 'white',hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = 'white', hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5, margin = margin(b = 10))
  )
```
